en.headline: Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival ends today at HKCEC
en.dek: The four-day tech fair focused on AI applications closes at 7 pm on Monday after drawing exhibitors and visitors to Hall 1 of the Convention and Exhibition Centre.
body: The Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival 2026 enters its final day on Monday at Hall 1 of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, with doors open from 10 am until 7 pm.

Organised by the Chamber of Hong Kong Computer Industry under the theme “AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future”, the event has featured more than 200 exhibitors across more than 600 booths covering computers, communications, electronics and digital transformation. A dedicated AI and digital transformation zone, co-organised with the Hong Kong Productivity Council and sponsored by Samsung, has highlighted practical applications of agentic AI for businesses and individuals.

Admission is HK$35, with free entry for children under one metre, people aged 65 or above and holders of valid disability registration cards. Visitors were advised that entry stops one hour before closing. The festival has also offered on-site trade-in services for older devices and a series of free workshops and forums throughout the four days.

zh.headline: 香港電腦通訊節今日閉幕 會展開放至晚上七時
zh.dek: 以人工智能應用為主題的四日科技展覽今日最後一日於灣仔會展一號展覽廳舉行，晚上七時結束。
body: 「香港電腦通訊節2026」今日（24日）進入最後一天，於灣仔香港會議展覽中心一號展覽廳舉行，開放時間為上午十時至晚上七時。
展覽由香港電腦商會主辦，主題為「AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future」，設有逾200家展商及600多個展位，涵蓋電腦、通訊、電子產品及數碼轉型等範疇。場內設有由香港生產力促進局合辦、三星冠名的「AI及數碼轉型專區」，展示代理型人工智能在商業及個人層面的實際應用。
門票售價港幣35元，一米以下小童、65歲或以上長者及合資格殘疾人士免費入場。每日閉館前60分鐘停止入場。展期內亦設有舊機即場變現服務及多場免費工作坊和論壇。
